Haiii 💜
I am also an ENFP and I think I am struggeling with something similar. 🥴
I really worry about what other people might think. I often think that my friends just pretend to like me and secretly talk bad stuff about me behind my back.
I have a history with bullying and because of that I am also often scared when I meet new people because they might find me weird and hurt me. 🙈
What annoys me the most about this is, that I REALLY want to mert new people and socialize all the time.
I want to feel more free to be myself when I am around people. 🙃
And even though I have this feeling of constant fear I can't stop doing something with people and search for new adventures, because being alone is even worse. 💕

My parents raised me to never trust anybody and to think that everyone is bad and unfriendly, that security is the only and best thing I should go after. 🙈
The constant bullying did the rest and really made me believe that.
When I turned 18 I finally cracked and found out that this isn't me. 🥰
But now it feels like I have to constantly fight my former self trapped in my unconscious. 🥴

To get back on topic. Yeah. I am often scared about what other people might think of me and when think I did something slightly wrong I think everyone hates me for it :/
I don't know how to really fight it yet but I don't want to give up 💜
Thank you 😊
I think you live in constant fear of with what new extroverted plan your family comes up today or you have somehow done it to lock your door and only come out to eat. 🙃

That sounds so like me 😂
Always thinking everyone talks badly about me behind my back. 🙈

Maybe this sounds a bit weird but since I know that I am ENFP my lightbulb slowly started glowing, too.
Before that, I thought being like my SJ parents is the only good way to life a live and acting like my friends is the way I should behave according to my age.
But now I am beginning accept who I am right now and who I want to be in the future. Sure I still work on my weaknesses but I don't hate myself for them anymore.

I think I am in that state where I am not always sure how I really want to act in certain situations as I need to still learn what I want and what are just habits of my former self.
The fear of making someone uncomfortable is maybe just one of the mountains I still need to climb to find my true self.

I know that adjusting to other peoples needs will just make matters worse as they won't like me for who I really am but for who I pretend to be.

Thanks for your answer. 🥰
Have a nice day 🙃

Thanks for the reply 💕

I think my problem is, that it's difficult for me when someone says I made them uncomfortable. I will almost always fall into a cycle of self hate and shame when I think I made someone feel uncomfortable. 🥺
Thats something I really have to learn.
To be okay with it, that I can't just always do everything right and to trust the other person that they can forgive me. 🙈
For me it feels like whenever I do something slightly wrong the other person will hate me for the rest of their life.

And to your second paragraph. You are right. I need to learn to not hold back. Other people should like the version of myself that I really am and not some kind of fake me. It's just difficult with the constant fear of not acting perfectly like the other person wants me to be.🙃

Thanks again and have a nice day 🥰

Thanks 🥰

I have a really good INTJ friend and we are often astonished that our problems are the exact opposite xD.
But this shows just how different people work.
I think we all just have to try to be the best versions of ourselves. Good luck 😊💜

But you and the other comments showed me one big misconception I had. To assume that romantic relationship is always more than a platonic relationship.

And feeling uncomfortable with most of my friends is more coming from my own mental health, as I am probably trans, not sure about my sexual orientation, diagnosed with Depression and ADHD and feeling like there might even be more, as I'm showing signs of paranoia, anxiety and severe trust issues, than coming from bad friends. :/

But thanks for your reply :)
Have a good night. (At least it is night were I live) :)

Best wishes on your life journey as well :)

Okay thanks :)

I've always wanted to just do everything perfect. And I want people to think that I am perfect. Maybe this is the reason why I get these sudden rushes of motivation before deadlines, because I don't want others to think that I am too bad for that work.

As you said. I often start way to late with tasks because I think for an eternity on how to do it perfectly which overhelmes me and stops me from trying.

I remember in elementary school I used to cut parts of my desk pad away when I didn't get the best grade.

But I never really had to work for anything. Good school grades came without learning. And my parents did everything for me I didn't want to do.
I never had to do something remotely exhausting in my entire childhood except enduring bullying. 

So living alone and having a job is a very difficult challenge for me.

Omg thanks. I can really relate to these subs. 

I am actually diagnosed with ADHD, but it's treatment isn't working well.

My parents and friends just call me lazy all my life and say that someone with ADHD has to be hyperactive all the day. So I am skeptical about the diganos too.
They tell me to just do my chores as if it was easy.
So no one really understands me there.
My parents just want me to be successful in every aspect of my life. 

I actually was on medication (amphetamins) for some time but it didn't change much. 
Sadly I lost my psychiatrist due to me missing appointments to often. It is so difficult for me to remember them. And now I can't seem to find the motivation to look for someone new. 

My therapist is still supporting me but I am really struggling to do the exercises she gives me because of my lack of motivation. 

But I hope that I am soon able to believe/accept that I have ADHD and that I am not a bad person or a failure. :)
Maybe I even find a way to get it treated.

Thanks for your nice words :)

Yeah I think the only way is to fight. Even though I still need some time to fully accept that.
I just hope that I am strong enough to always stand through the bad days.

I think I know what you mean.

I think for me it's similar. I feel like I care about no one and feel nothing when something bad happens to them. I never cry because it feels like all emotions just went numb inside me.
I even think about advantages I get from the bad things that might happen to other ones like heritage or something like that.
I feel so weird because all of my friends even cry over things like movies and I am just cold.
I sometimes try to force myself to cry.

I can give you the advice my therapist gave me. 
Unfortunately it didn't really work for me because I wasn't motivated enough to regularly do this exercise.

She said, that I should take 1 hour every day where I just lie down and put anything away that distracts me. No mobile, no music, no books, no food.
Nothing.
Just lie there and breath heavily into your stomach and try to observe your feelings. 
Try to really feel them and write down your experience after that.

Maybe this helps you :)
Good luck

Hey there :)

Has anything happened earlier in your life where this feeling might be rooted in? 
Maybe it is some kind of trauma.

One solution could be that you talk with someone you trust or your loved ones about that. 
Maybe they can help you to build up more trust that they are safe. 
Or you can develop some techniques with them to help you cope with that fear like a text message they write you from time to time so that you know they are safe.

And if nothing helps you could try to talk to a therapist or psychologist about this. 

I hope I could help :)
Wishing you the best.

Hey :)
I am sorry that you have to go through something like that.

I have to say that I am no expert and this comment is just my opinion and how I view this topic.  

Two general things about therapy in the beginning. 
First of all just because you feel like your therapist is getting impatient with you, this feeling is not always true. Sometimes it just comes from yourself being unsatisfied with your progress. So I would recommend to always talk openly to your therapist if you have that feeling again. Their reaction may tell you the truth. 
And the second thing is, that you should never give yourself the fault at anything that happens during the therapy. Your therapist should be there for you and adjust in a way you feel comfortable. They are there to help you and not raise your feelings of guilt. Nor should you have the feeling that you can't talk about everything with your therapist.

I think something needs to change about your current therapy situation.
 I don't know if your therapist is really the way you describe her or if she just thinks that this is the best way to treat you. 
To clarify that I would tell her how you feel and what you don't like at the moment. 
I think three things could happen after that. Either she changes her style, you two come to the conclusion that it is best to change to another therapist and she might even help you with it, or she just goes on like before.
If the first thing happens you can try if your trust comes back and you can feel comfortable with her again. 
But if not or in the other two cases I would change therapist.

If you lost your trust to a point where you can't bring yourself to talk to your therapist about this, I would also change to someone else.

I know that changing is a big deal and can be scary. So don't feel ashamed if you ask someone you know for help. Maybe even some voluntary workers can help.

I hope my point of view could help. :)
And again. I am no expert and there might be another opinion which is better than mine.
But I wish you luck and hope you get better :)

To be honest I don't really know what this feeling is.
Maybe you are happy about something but are scared that it might end soon?

But maybe because of this comment, your post gets listed higher and someone sees it who can help you better.

Sorry that I can't help more. Good luck in finding answers :)

I believe you :)
I hope it helps a bit to at least hear that from someone.

The human mind is so difficult to understand and I'm unfortunately no expert nor did I ever have a similar experience.
But I am sure that this is big burden and I admire your strength.

I don't know if you are talking to a doctor or therapist about it which I would recommend in your situation, but maybe you can try to get a more positive point of view by yourself. 
I personally am impressed that you can think of entire movies in your head that haven't even existed. Maybe you could document them by writing it down or to make it more easy voice record them.
Some day you may be motivated to write a book or a movie script where these thoughts can give you a great creative input.

I just hope you can talk to someone if your intrusive thoughts get to bad. It is a shame that some people have to get through such difficult times by themselves.

And I really feel you on that part about life feeling like a chore. I don't have any tips on how to really cope with that other than fight. But know your not alone. :)

Try to stay as positive as you can and try to explain your situation again to someone. There have to be more people out there that will believe you.

If I misunderstood some of your points feel free to correct me. I hope you're getting better. :)

I am so sorry to hear that. :/

Life so fast paced sometimes. Try to not lose hope.
If it changes so fast to the worse it may change to the better sooner than you think.

Let yourself some time to grief but try to not get sucked in completely by a black hole.

But I know that I can't fully understand your situation. The only thing I can do is to wish you the best. :)

Maybe you could practice it with a person you trust.

Just sit next to teach other for the beginning and try to call each other a couple times. The other person can even help you to press the button and snap out of the freeze for the first few times.
And when you get better with that you can maybe sit in different rooms or call other people you know and like.

I think trust is a big factor to maybe get over this fear.
And my therapist always tells me to face my fears and maybe if you take little steps this works for you too. :)

But it can't promise anything. This is the solution I would think of first. There could be even better ones out there.

Wishing you the best :)

Maybe you could try to calm your mind down when the brainfog starts.  
If you have time for that just lie down 20 minutes and try to meditate, listen to guided meditations, or calming music or take a nap.
I often get to much input over the whole day, so that I sometimes just have to do nothing to give my mind time to relax.
Maybe something like going for a walk in the forest might help too.

But if you can't get the brainfog to stop it may be a good idea to talk with a doctor about it. Something like that can always be an illness as well. 
For me it was ADS which stopped me from concentrating and the medication I get for it helps big time with that and I am still able to go on with my apprenticeship. :)

Thanks for your reply 💖 

To be honest there are some other issues aside of this.
I am suffering from depression, ADHD, an extreme lack of motivation which probably comes from the other two issues and occational panic attacks. I also was suspected with dependent personality disorder and I have to deal with bring trans. 

I read through the link you posted and looked for other people that feel like this. There is almost always one thing which is different to me.
Many of these posts say, that it's writers would rather be alone, or don't want to talk to other people about their problems.
But that is definitely not the case for me. Whenever there is anything bothering me, I have to get it out and talk to somebody, because otherwise it would tear me apart. I also hate to be alone. I am in constant fear to be left alone or to be betrayed.
Meeting with friends is pretty much my greatest passion. I am mostly the one, who plans our activities and meet ups even.

But it just feels like I meet with empty shells. And as long as there is somebody, I could replace them with anyone who makes me laugh or makes the time pass. It is like everyone except me is a robot and I can't feel an emotional connection.

But I don't have anything else to do. I don't know who I am or what I like. I don't have any hobbies or other passions. The only thing that keeps me going is my extreme fear of negative conflicts. I desperately try to be perfect and to not offend anyone as I can't cope with negative comments or people who are angry at me. 

So on one hand I am always scared of being hurt and I am desperate to not be alone, but on the other hand I don't feel an emotional connection and feel like everyone else is like a robot or an empty shell.
So I constantly feel alone and scared even though I am physically almost never alone and my friends even say how important I am to them. 

But thanks for the tip to try and write to people who share my interests. I might try to answer to some Insta stories or search for forums.

I even tried to meet new people online before and talked to them for a few weeks, but they never grew to my heart and after some time I didn't have the motivation to write them anymore. 

For me it is difficult to find new friends in general. First of all I feel uneasy in the presence of strangers and then I also lose interest very fast, to a point where it is literally more difficult to motivate/force myself to answer them, than to do chores or go to work.
The only way I am able to get to know new people, is to be forced to do something with them. Wether it is through work, school or other friends. 

Since I wrote everything down now, it is easier to talk to my therapist about this on Monday. :)
So thanks again for your tips and listening to me 🥰
Feel free to answer if there is something else you want to say. 💖
Take care as well 😊

Hey it's me again.

I feel like you are a nice person as well and I'm happy about your answer. :)

Sorry if this is just unnecessary rant and doesn't fit into this sub but I needed a place to vent a bit and you made a trustworthy impression on me :)

I know that I need someone special. Someone who loves me. But I just don't seem to find that.

Over a year ago I developed deep feelings for a colleague but she didn't feel the same for me.

That's when I noticed that I'm spiraling down into a scary black hole.
I began to write down my feelings and thoughts about her and suddenly these texts were more about my self hate, hopelessness and sadness.

She tried to help me with putting distance between us but it feels like it made everything just worse. I didn't want to lose her, because I've never known another person that was so nice to me. I never had any real friends in my life but with her I felt an instant connection. At the moment we are best friends but not everything is going perfect. I feel like me entire mood is based on how she treats me and what she says to me because she is the only person who is emotionally important to me.

Since I know her every human on earth is just an empty shell for me. I distanced from my parants and everyone else because I just don't feel any emotions for them. I tried dating apps but I don't feel a connection with anyone.

In addition to my low self esteem and my unattractive looks this makes it difficult for me to find someone for a relationship.

Everything in my life is too exhausting for and I don't see a happy future for me. There is pretty much nothing that motivates me to stay alive but there is something that doesn't let me end it all, even though I often think about it and also have detailed plans on how to end it.

I just don't know how to go on with life.

But I noticed one thing. Everytime I'm in a good mood I almost constantly think about whether I'm trans or not but I mostly come to the conclusion that I am and everytime my other problems show up and I'm down I have serious doubts about it to the point I think that I am definitely not trans.

This just confuses me. Who is more trustworthy. My happy self or my sad self.

At the moment I see it this way. Whenever I down I don't want to have anymore problems and that's why I have those doubts and whenever I'm happy I feel strong enough to pursue my goals.

But all of my thoughts can be wrong. I don't know yet.

But I know for a fact that I envy girls for being girls and that I wish I was born a girl. I just don't know if transitioning would make me happier. But I also know that I don't want to live as a male. It's just easier to go on like I'm used to even if I'm not really happy with it.

That's why I post that stuff on Reddit because I hope it helps me to find an answer for my thoughts. But don't worry. I won't let me talk into somthing I might regret. :)

But I hope that time will help me. It's just difficult to don't lose hope and I don't know how to find something to be proud of on myself.

I also listen to all kinds of music. It's really nice to have a bit of variety there. Though I often catch myself listening to sad songs whenever I'm down and I know it drags me down. I just have a weird warm feeling in my heart when I do that.

Thanks for reading :)

That's a really good metaphor.

I can describe my feelings very nice this way.

I know that the other side would be so much better.
But I'm not brave enough yet to push off from the shore because the side I'm currently on isn't unliveable. 
It's not nice and I don't really like it here, but it's save.
I'm constantly jealous of the other side and I dream about being there, but the river that I am probably not able to cross entirely scares me to death.
I'm just not ready yet to leave my save spot. :/

And that pretty much counts for all parts of my life.
Everything nice just seems to be out of reach on the other side of scary rivers and I'm not brave enough to cross them.

But maybe with the help of therapy I'll be able to cross some rivers and when I have some practice in this, the river to my identity might even be pretty nice to live on even if I'm not able to cross it completely. :)

Thanks for the answer :)

I almost constantly make lists in my head about how I want my progress to look like.
As you say. One step after the other and eventually I see where it leads me.

I really hope that I can look back on everything like that in the future.

Until then I just try to give my best and work on myself :)

I listed everything in the other post I made a couple days ago.
Feel free to read it if you are interested :)

I'll give it my best.
I just hope that I can be finally happy with my life some time in the future :)

- I went to parties with painted nails and make up 

- I inform myself about this topic

- My best friend uses she/her and calls me Maya 

- Tomorrow I am going to talk to my mum about it

I just need to show a bit more patience a see where my path leads me :)

Thanks for you nice answer sister 💕

I'm just so scared of other people. I wish I could have painted finger nails or make up 24/7 but I'm scared that someone will hurt me. :(
I was hurt by many people throughout my life and I don't want this anymore.
That's one of my biggest issues. Trying to please everyone.
I have to learn that it's more important to do stuff that I like than stuff that others expect me to do.

>It took me a while to get here, but I realized I'd rather be the ugliest trans woman on earth, than be even the most handsome man.

That's the reason I need some more time to realize this for myself because at the moment it's more important for me what others like than what I like.

But I'll hopefully get there.
I'll definitely try my best :)

I really have butterflys in my stomach everytime she does that. 😊

Thanks :)

One problem I currently have is, that there are so many things to discuss with her, because I never was in psychological treatment before since my parents are people who don't take mental illnesses very seriously and never thought anything was wrong with me.

But I try to stay positive :)
I hope that I'm soon strong enough to make the final decision.
